Problem Statement
Write a program to determine whether a person is eligible to vote using a user-defined exception.
Description
Read the age of a person.
Perform the following operations:
If age is less than 18, throw a user-defined exception named AgeNotEligibleException.
Otherwise display that the person is eligible to vote.
Handle the exception and display an appropriate message.
